scope: Complete 13px initial table-search placeholder bitmaps in Linux ru/en. Alternate native 11px initialization states are measured but remain unimplemented; complete fields/toolbars/forms are not accepted.

nativeInputs.scope: Complete native 13px initial search placeholder bitmaps. The same XML also has recorded 11px native variants after another form; these are retained as unresolved states, not accepted or masked.

implementation: Shared NativeLabel adds a tableSearch placement with the measured left inset and baseline; initial 13px regular/10pt Linux hints are calibrated, other fonts retain the browser placeholder and existing approximation notice.
The search control starts at an integer 2px top inset. Its LCD text uses #c8c8c8 over white, independently of the clear-button foreground.
The real input remains read-only and hit-testable. Clicking it selects source identity 8 in Default; no input value or XML is saved.
The LCD bitmap clips at the text viewport before the clear button. The calibration covers the recorded normal/wide input sizes; complete narrow-layout and outline/clear-button states remain open.
Native first/next form probes show both 13px/gray and 11px/yellow variants for the same XML, including ReadOnly first and Default second. No ReadOnly-only selection rule is inferred or implemented.

nativeInitializationProbes.interpretation: The records establish multiple native initialization states, not a general cause or exhaustive transition rule. The 11px variant remains an explicit missing state.

beforeFix.source: Existing full PNGs, measured against the same complete 13px reference bitmaps; no source XML changed.

remaining: Alternate native 11px/yellow initialization states and their selection rule remain unimplemented. These states are not masked or waived.

Search outline/corners/clear button and complete field states, standard icons, grouped buttons and lower-border repaint differences remain open. Both complete-toolbar reference variants still fail on all four forms in both locales.
All widths/fonts/style combinations, Windows, other DPI, native property inventory and full-profile acceptance remain open.
